paragraphs.en: Oh, little prince! Gradually, I came to understand your sorrowful life. You found joy in watching sunsets.
paragraphs.zh: 哦，小王子！渐渐地，我开始理解你那充满哀愁的生活。你在欣赏日落时找到了快乐。

paragraphs.en: On the fourth day, you invited me to see one together.
paragraphs.zh: 第四天，你邀请我一起去看看。

paragraphs.en: "Let's go watch a sunset," you said.
paragraphs.zh: “我们去看日落吧。”你脱口而出。
“但我们必须等等才行。”我回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Why do we need to wait?" you asked.
"For the sunset," I explained. "We must wait until it is time."
paragraphs.zh: “等夕阳西下，”我解释道，“我们必须等到那个时候。”

paragraphs.en: Initially, you seemed surprised. Then you laughed and said, "I always think I'm at home!"
paragraphs.zh: 起初你显得有些惊讶，随后你笑了笑，说道：“我总是觉得自己在家呢！”

paragraphs.en: Indeed, if you could fly to France in a minute, you could see the sunset right from noon. But your planet was too far for that. On your tiny world, all you needed to do was move your chair a few steps.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你们能瞬间飞抵法国，中午就能看到日落。但你们的星球距离太远，做不到这一点。在你们这个小小的世界上，只要挪动几把椅子的位置就行了。

paragraphs.en: "One day," you told me, "I saw forty-four sunsets."
paragraphs.zh: “有一天，”你告诉我，“我见证了四十四次日落。”

paragraphs.en: You continued, "When one is so sad, they love the sunset."
paragraphs.zh: 你继续说道：“悲伤时，人们总是钟情于夕阳。”
